faqs.q: Is the IDFC FIRST Quantum+ Credit Card a secured credit card?
faqs.a: Yes. The IDFC FIRST Quantum+ Credit Card is a secured credit card backed by a fixed deposit of Rs. 10,000, which serves as collateral for the credit limit.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on the cashback I can earn?
faqs.a: Yes. The total cashback across all eligible spending categories is capped at Rs. 500 per statement cycle, regardless of your overall monthly spending.

faqs.q: What insurance benefits are included with this card?
faqs.a: The card provides a personal accident cover of Rs. 2 lakh and a lost card liability cover of up to Rs. 25,000, subject to the banks applicable terms and conditions.
Utility bill payments, rent, jewellery purchases, wallet loads, insurance premiums, and government service payments earn 0.5% cashback instead of the standard cashback rates.

faqs.q: What happens if I do not pay my credit card bill on time?
faqs.a: Unpaid balances attract finance charges of 3.99% per month (47.88% per annum), and a late payment fee is charged based on the outstanding amount, subject to the banks fee limits.
